title: The Summer of the Old Mill House
author: Tamsin Coldharbour
blurb: Paloma Eriksen, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
